text: bhikkhave bhikkhu āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato paṭimukkassa mārapāso bandho 1 so mārabandhanena yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato .pe. santi bhikkhave jivhāviññeyyā rasā .pe. santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati . ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato paṭimukkassa mārapāso bandho so mārabandhanena yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato . [166] santi ca kho bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā
